text: Jardine Cycle & Carriage's Annual Report 2023 lists its interest in Astra as 50.1%; Astra is a business group listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange.
short: Jardine Cycle & Carriage holds 50.1% of Astra International (listed, Indonesia Stock Exchange).

source.name: Jardine Cycle & Carriage - Annual Report 2023: Astra
source.quote: Astra (50.1%) is a leading business group operating in Indonesia and listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange.
